import requests, json, collections, time
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"research-agent/1.0"}
accs={'HUMAN':'Q8IV36','MOUSE':'Q8R1F6','RAT':'D4A0C3','DICDI':'Q54JJ6','SCHPO_hid1':'O13776',
 'SCHPO_hid3':'Q9P7M6','SCHPO_hid2':'Q9HDV3','YEAST_ECM30':'Q06673','DANRE':'A0AC58J458',
 'DROME':'Q52KA6','CAEEL':'G5EG65','XENTR':'A0A8J0T003','CIOIN':'H2XV68','IXOSC':'A0ACM8DY32'}
S={n:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",headers=H,timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]) for n,a in accs.items()}
B62="""A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
AA="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"; sub={}
for line in B62.strip().split("\n"):
    p=line.split()
    for c,v in zip(AA,p[1:]): sub[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
sc=lambda a,b: sub.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(q,t,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(q),len(t); NEG=-1e9
    Mp=[NEG]*(m+1); Xp=[NEG]*(m+1); Yp=[NEG]*(m+1); Mp[0]=0
    for j in range(1,m+1): Xp[j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    ptr=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        M=[NEG]*(m+1); X=[NEG]*(m+1); Y=[NEG]*(m+1); Y[0]=go+ge*(i-1)
        row=bytearray(m+1); qi=q[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            best=Mp[j-1]; st=0
            if Xp[j-1]>best: best=Xp[j-1]; st=1
            if Yp[j-1]>best: best=Yp[j-1]; st=2
            M[j]=best+sc(qi,t[j-1])
            a=M[j-1]+go; b=X[j-1]+ge; X[j]=a if a>=b else b
            c=Mp[j]+go; d=Yp[j]+ge; Y[j]=c if c>=d else d
            row[j]=st|(0 if a>=b else 4)|(0 if c>=d else 8)
        ptr.append(row); Mp,Xp,Yp=M,X,Y
    i,j=n,m; state=int(np.argmax([Mp[m],Xp[m],Yp[m]])); pairs=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        r=ptr[i-1][j]
        if state==0: pairs.append((i,j)); state=r&3; i-=1; j-=1
        elif state==1: state=0 if not (r&4) else 1; j-=1
        else: state=0 if not (r&8) else 2; i-=1
    return pairs
hum=S['HUMAN']; L=len(hum); cols=collections.defaultdict(list)
for n,s in S.items():
    if n=='HUMAN': continue
    for i,j in nw(hum,s): cols[i].append(s[j-1])
cons=np.array([np.mean([c==hum[i-1] for c in cols[i]]) if cols[i] else 0 for i in range(1,L+1)])

pdb=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8IV36-F1-model_v6.pdb",headers=H,timeout=180).text
PAE=np.array(requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8IV36-F1-predicted_aligned_error_v6.json",headers=H,timeout=180).json()[0]["predicted_aligned_error"],float)
at=collections.defaultdict(list); plb={}
for l in pdb.splitlines():
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        n=int(l[22:26]); at[n].append((float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
        if l[12:16].strip()=="CA": plb[n]=float(l[60:66])
N=max(at); plddt=np.array([plb[i] for i in range(1,N+1)])
cent=np.array([np.mean(at[i],axis=0) for i in range(1,N+1)])
D=np.linalg.norm(cent[:,None,:]-cent[None,:,:],axis=-1)
nbr=(D<10.0).sum(1)-1
thr=np.percentile(nbr,40); exposed=nbr<=thr
print(f"burial proxy: median nbr {np.median(nbr):.0f}; exposed <= {thr:.0f} ({exposed.sum()} res)")

core=np.arange(0,600); ct=np.arange(689,788)
cmask=D[np.ix_(core,ct)]<10
print(f"\nCore(1-600)<->Cterm(690-788) contacts <10A: {cmask.sum()} pairs")
print("  core residues:", (np.where(cmask.any(1))[0]+1).tolist())
print("  Cterm residues:",(np.where(cmask.any(0))[0]+690).tolist())
print(f"  mean PAE core-vs-Cterm {PAE[np.ix_(core,ct)].mean():.1f} A | within core {PAE[np.ix_(core,core)].mean():.1f} | within Cterm {PAE[np.ix_(ct,ct)].mean():.1f} | core-vs-linker(571-689) {PAE[np.ix_(core,np.arange(570,689))].mean():.1f}")

hi=exposed&(cons>=0.85)&(plddt>70); idx=np.where(hi)[0]
par=list(range(len(idx)))
def find(a):
    while par[a]!=a: par[a]=par[par[a]]; a=par[a]
    return a
for a in range(len(idx)):
    for b in range(a+1,len(idx)):
        if D[idx[a],idx[b]]<8.0:
            ra,rb=find(a),find(b)
            if ra!=rb: par[ra]=rb
cl=collections.defaultdict(list)
for a in range(len(idx)): cl[find(a)].append(idx[a]+1)
patches=sorted([sorted(v) for v in cl.values() if len(v)>=6],key=lambda v:-len(v))
print(f"\nconserved (>=85% id) exposed confident residues: {len(idx)}; patches >=6 res: {len(patches)}")
for p in patches[:8]:
    segs=[];s=p[0];prev=p[0]
    for r in p[1:]:
        if r-prev>4: segs.append((s,prev)); s=r
        prev=r
    segs.append((s,prev))
    frac_ct=np.mean([r>=690 for r in p])
    print(f"  size {len(p):>2} (frac in Cterm {frac_ct:.2f}) segs {['%d-%d:%s'%(a,b,hum[a-1:b]) for a,b in segs]}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(13,9),sharex=True)
ax=axes[0]; ax.plot(range(1,N+1),100*cons,lw=0.6,color="#888")
ax.plot(range(1,N+1),np.convolve(100*cons,np.ones(15)/15,mode="same"),lw=2,color="#c0392b")
for lo,hi_,c,lab in [(2,20,"#2ecc71","myristoyl + polybasic"),(690,788,"#3498db","C-terminal functional domain"),(571,689,"#bdc3c7","disordered linker")]:
    ax.axvspan(lo,hi_,color=c,alpha=0.35,lw=0); ax.text((lo+hi_)/2,104,lab,ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("% identity to human\n(13 orthologs)"); ax.set_ylim(0,112)
ax.set_title("HID1 conservation, model confidence and burial (human Q8IV36 numbering)")
axes[1].plot(range(1,N+1),plddt,lw=0.8,color="#2a6ebb"); axes[1].axhline(70,ls="--",c="grey",lw=0.8); axes[1].set_ylabel("pLDDT")
axes[2].plot(range(1,N+1),nbr,lw=0.8,color="#8e44ad"); axes[2].axhline(thr,ls="--",c="grey",lw=0.8)
axes[2].set_ylabel("neighbour count\n(burial proxy)"); axes[2].set_xlabel("residue")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5,5.5))
im=ax.imshow(PAE,cmap="viridis_r"); 
for x in (600,690): ax.axhline(x,c="w",lw=0.6); ax.axvline(x,c="w",lw=0.6)
plt.colorbar(im,label="predicted aligned error (A)")
ax.set_title("HID1 PAE map: solenoid core 1-600, linker 571-689,\nC-terminal domain 690-788")
ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("residue"); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
